glyospalettes: Color Palettes Inspired by Glyos Colorways

Source: R/glyospalettes-package.R
glyospalettes-package.Rd

Color palettes based on the named production colorways of the Glyos System Series toy line by Onell Design, plus ggplot2 color and fill scales.

Details

Start with glyos_palette() to pull colors from a colorway, glyos_palette_names() to list the available colorways, and scale_colour_glyos() / scale_fill_glyos() to use them in ggplot2. Run glyos_show_palettes() to see every palette at once.

Hex values are approximations curated from product photography and from Onell Design's published color descriptions. glyospalettes is a fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Onell Design.
